MAMBA Weekly Group Ride

Morgantown, WV · Mountain bike

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

MAMBA Weekly Group Ride is a mountain bike group ride in Morgantown, WV. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:30 pm. Pace: beginner/intermediate, regroups along the trail. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: beginner/intermediate, regroups along the trail. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @mambawv the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the MAMBA Weekly Group Ride group ride

Board members host a weekly trail ride for members, friends and families. Beginner-to-intermediate level with regular regroups. The point is learning the trails and having a good time.
